sentences.text: Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Desh Ratan Chaudhary Hon'ble Rahul Chaturvedi,J.
Sunil Kumar, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Desh Ratan Chaudhary, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and learned AGA for the State.

By means of the present application, the applicants are assailing the legality and validity of the entire proceeding of criminal case no. 1890 of 2012 as well as charge sheet dated 05.10.2022 in case crime no. 1298 of 2021 under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B, 504 and 506 IPC, P.S. Khurza Nagar, District Bulandshahar pending in the court of A.C.J.M., Khurza, Bulandshahar and cognizance order dated 19.10.2022 passed by A.C.J.M., Khurza, Bulandshahar.
Learned counsel for the applicants has straightway drawn the attention of the Court to the summoning order dated 19.10.2022 passed by concerned Magistrate and as per the learned counsel for the applicant, this is non speaking and cryptic order, which does not reflect any application of Parvez Khan And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73231650/
1 mind while passing the summoning order in this regard.
Learned counsel for the applicants has relied upon the order of coordinate Bench of this Court in 482 Cr.P.C. Application No. 2950 of 2023 (Aarif Vs. State of U.P. and another) decided on 01.02.2023, whereby the coordinate Bench of this Court in this regard in paragraph 11 and 12 of the order set aside the order impugned and remanded the matter back for fresh consideration within a period of three weeks from the receipt of the order.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Paragraph 11 and 12 of the aforesaid judgement is quoted herein below:

"11. In the present case the only irresistible conclusion is that the Magistrate concerned has passed a totally cryptic order which does not, in any manner, reflect his application of mind and stand to the test of a judicial order expected to have been passed as per the legislature and laws.

The nature of order being totally non-speaking, lack of opinion about prima-facie case being made out clearly reflects total non application of mind due to which it cannot stand to the settled parameters of an order under Section 204 Cr.P.C.
12.

In view of the same, the order dated 25.8.2022 (second order of the said date)
summoning the applicant is hereby set aside.
The matter is remanded to the concerned court to pass afresh order in accordance with law within three weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order."

Perusal of the impugned summoning order dated 19.10.2022 suffers from same vice and defect i.e.
non-application of judicial mind as in the earlier case (Application U/S 482 No. 2950 of 2023).
Thus, the present 482 Cr.P.C. application stands dispose of with the same terms and condition.
During next four weeks
, the learned Magistrate concerned is required to give detailed order spelling out the reasons for satisfaction by speaking order.
Accordingly, the cognizance order dated 19.10.2022 passed by A.C.J.M., Khurza, Bulandshahar is hereby set aside with the aforesaid directions.
It is open for the applicant to file fresh petition assailing the merit of the case by means of subsequent proceeding.
With this observation, the present 482 Cr.P.C. application stands dispose of.

Order Date :- 21.2.2023 Abhishek Sri.
